name: Coscientist
one_liner: Autonomous chemical research system that generates liquid-handler control scripts and runs palladium-catalyzed cross-couplings, with its condition optimization run against previously collected, fully mapped yield datasets.

loop.proposes: An LLM planner designs reaction matrices and writes Opentrons Python protocol scripts and hardware commands.
loop.judged_by: Protocol syntax checkers, robotic liquid handlers, and UV-vis plate readers execute the reactions and measure product yield.
loop.steers: The optimization study selects conditions against previously collected, fully mapped yield datasets.

headline_result: Autonomously executed Suzuki-Miyaura and Sonogashira cross-coupling reactions on cloud lab hardware and ran an optimization study that selected conditions against previously collected, fully mapped yield datasets.
caveat: Wet-lab loop throughput is bounded by physical incubation and analytical characterization times.
beyond_harness_note: Physical robotic reactors and spectrophotometric yield measurements judge the proposed experimental protocols.
generative_model: GPT-4 experimental planner and protocol synthesizer
algorithmic_authority: Opentrons robotic execution validator and UV-vis spectrophotometer

sources.title: Autonomous chemical research with large language models (Nature, 2023)

verification.notes: Checked against Boiko et al., Nature 624, 2023.
